units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp reads and writes MSG and EML email formats. It converts email messages between MSG and EML representations. It creates new email messages and saves them in MSG or EML format. It loads existing email messages from streams or files and exposes their content.
Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer, working with file paths, in-memory streams, or raw byte buffers.
Parse and reconstruct the raw MSG directory/stream structure with msg_reader, msg_document, and msg_writer, including an optional strict-validation mode surfaced through validation_issues().

Create, edit, save, and reload Outlook-style messages through mapi_message, setting the subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity, or reaching arbitrary MAPI properties via set_property()/get_property_value() with common_message_property_id and property_type_code.

Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient(), attach regular files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment(), and nest a full mapi_message as an embedded-message attachment with add_embedded_message_attachment().
Save an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and load .eml back into a mapi_message, both through the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.

Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp provides the mapi_message class as the primary high-level entry point for creating, editing, and reloading messages, while lower-level classes such as msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, cfb_reader, cfb_document, and cfb_writer expose the underlying MSG and CFB container structure directly for callers that need it.

The aspose.email.foss namespace hosts the public API surface for MSG and CFB file handling, with mapi_message serving as the main entry point for message authoring and the low-level msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, cfb_reader, cfb_document, and cfb_writer classes providing direct access to the container structure.
It adds mail-protocol connectivity, PST archive support, and broader MAPI property and format coverage across the full commercial product line.
cfb_document class provides methods to load a Compound File Binary document from a buffer, bytes, file, reader, or stream, and exposes its major_version, minor_version, and root.
cfb_exception class represents an exception type for errors in Compound File Binary processing.
cfb_node class represents a node in a Compound File Binary structure and provides methods to access its name, clsid, creation_time, modified_time, and state whether it is a storage or stream.

cfb_reader class provides methods to read a Compound File Binary document from a buffer, bytes, file, or stream and exposes its header, directory_entries, fat, mini_fat, difat, and various entry and stream accessors.
cfb_storage class represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to add child storages or streams and access its children.
cfb_stream class represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to access and set its data.
cfb_writer class provides methods to write a Compound File Binary document to bytes, a file, or a stream.
directory_color_flag enum lists the black and red color flags used in directory entries.

directory_entry class represents a directory entry in a Compound File Binary document and provides fields for child_id, clsid, color_flag, creation_time, directory_entry_name_length, and methods to determine if it is the root, a storage, or a stream.
directory_object_type enum lists the root_storage_object, storage_object, stream_object, and unknown_or_unallocated object types used in directory entries.

header class represents the header of a Compound File Binary document and provides fields for byte_order, difat, first_difat_sector_location, first_directory_sector_location, first_mini_fat_sector_location, header_clsid, header_signature, and major_version.
sector_marker enum lists the difsect, endofchain, fatsect, and freesect sector markers used in the file allocation table.

common_message_property_id enum lists property identifiers such as attach_content_id, attach_data_binary, attach_filename, attach_long_filename, attach_method, attach_mime_tag, body, body_html, display_bcc, display_cc, display_name, and display_to.

mapi_attachment class represents a MAPI attachment and provides fields for content_id, data, embedded_message, filename, and methods to load from bytes or stream, determine if it is an embedded message, and load its data.
mapi_message class represents a MAPI message and provides methods to add attachments, embedded messages, and recipients, and exposes the attachments and body.
mapi_property class represents a MAPI property and provides methods to access and set its flags, property_id, property_tag, property_type, and value.
mapi_property_collection class provides methods to add, get, set, remove, and access items in a collection of MAPI properties.
mapi_recipient class represents a MAPI recipient and provides fields for address_type, display_name, email_address, properties, and recipient_type.

msg_document class provides methods to load a MSG document from a file, reader, or stream, and exposes its major_version, minor_version, root, strict flag, and the ability to convert to a cfb_document.
msg_exception class represents an exception type for errors in MSG processing.
msg_reader class provides methods to load a MSG document from a file or stream and exposes its cfb document, strict flag, and validation_issues.

msg_storage class represents a storage node in a MSG document and provides methods to add child storages or streams and access its clsid, creation_time, modified_time, name, and find child storages or streams.
msg_storage_role enum lists the attachment, custom_attachment, embedded_message, generic, message, named_property_mapping, and recipient roles for MSG storages.
msg_stream class represents a stream node in a MSG document and provides fields for clsid, creation_time, data, modified_time, name, and state_bits.
msg_writer class provides methods to write a MSG document to bytes, a file, or a stream.

property_type_code enum lists property type codes such as ptyp_binary, ptyp_boolean, ptyp_currency, ptyp_error_code, ptyp_floating32, ptyp_floating64, ptyp_floating_time, ptyp_guid, ptyp_integer16, ptyp_integer32, ptyp_integer64, and ptyp_multiple_binary.
